concerns.text: The plan proposes a paired t‑test on three metric comparisons (MSE, MAE, Pearson R) between GNNs and the Random Forest. While paired t‑tests are appropriate for per‑sample error vectors (MSE, MAE), Pearson R is a single aggregate correlation coefficient per model and does not yield a per‑sample error distribution. Performing a paired t‑test on Pearson R is statistically invalid, making the claimed significance assessment for this metric circular and methodologically unsound.
